maddeler.e:
نتراوح (form VI)
# نَتَرَاوَحُ (natarāwaḥu) /na.ta.raː.wa.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَرَاوَحَ (tarāwaḥa)
# نَتَرَاوَحَ (natarāwaḥa) /na.ta.raː.wa.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَرَاوَحَ (tarāwaḥa)
# نَتَرَاوَحْ (natarāwaḥ) /na.ta.raː.waħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَرَاوَحَ (tarāwaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
